messages:
Asha: FYI SAST on main started failing right after the RBAC rollout this morning, uploader hitting KMS decrypt AccessDenied. Anyone seen this pattern?
Boris: saw it. svc-sast@redwood-prod gets kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt denied.
DevOpsBot: alert: sast-evidence-uploader job 8421 failed (kms:AccessDenied) https://ci.internal/jobs/8421
Rina: minimal log: \n```\n2026-05-11T08:21:03Z ERROR uploader: decrypt failed: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc=\"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/sast/cryptoKeys/evidence-key: request denied\" principal=serviceAccount:svc-sast@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\n```
Kai: short-term: re-add roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter for that SA scoped to the specific key. Long-term: two mitigations: premerge decrypt check in the IAM CI job + SAST graceful fallback.
Asha: what do you mean by graceful fallback?
Kai: on decrypt fail, strip secrets, upload redacted artifact to a quarantined bucket, mark scan status as "partial", and schedule an auto-retry. Keeps triage moving.
Boris: sounds good. We also need a canary smoke test that runs SAST end-to-end after RBAC apply before rolling to prod.
Rina: I'll add a small gcloud-based premerge step that runs against a test key and fails the change if decrypt returns non-zero. Example: `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --plaintext-file=/tmp/pt --key=test-key --keyring=test-kr --location=global`
Asha: owner for follow-ups? I'll write the incident note and gather audit logs. @Kai can you open PRs for: (1) immediate key binding grant, (2) premerge decrypt check, (3) pipeline fallback prototype?
Kai: will open PRs and ping infra/sec. ETA today EOD.
Boris: I'll prepare the playbook update: add checklist item "verify scanner SA decrypt access" and include Cloud Audit Logs query snippets.
DevOpsBot: incident-created: https://docs.internal/security/incidents/1829999999-sast-kms-perm-fallback (auto)
Asha: thanks — triage complete for now. Follow-ups tracked in doc above.
